NONE: › used to show you are very surprised
（表示驚訝）天哪！ 哎呀！
› an expression of great surprise
天哪！真難以置信！

example: 「凱特要結婚了。」「是嗎，真難以置信！」

NONE: › used to say that you certainly do not know
如果我知道，我就不得好死。
› used to express your determination not to do something or not to allow someone else to do something
我絕不會…；讓…見鬼去吧

example: I'll be hanged if I'm going to clean up after him!
我才不會跟在他後面整理他弄亂的東西呢！

NONE: › I'm surprised
大吃一驚

example: "Did you know that Ann was pregnant?" "Well, I'll be jiggered!"
「你知道安懷孕了嗎？」「啊，我太驚訝了！」

NONE: › used to say that you are sure something will not happen
我敢打賭…絕對不可能發生，要是…發生我把頭給你

example: If she actually marries him I'll eat my hat.
她要是真的會嫁給他，我就把腦袋給你。

NONE: › used to show that you agree very strongly with what has been said
當然！的確如此！
› used to ask someone, in an annoyed way, to do something
請你…（表示惱火）

example: I'll thank you to leave my private papers alone.
請你不要動我的私人文件。

NONE: › something you say when you are angry with someone
（表示非常生氣）我會擰斷你／他／她的脖子！

example: I'll wring his neck if he does that again!
他要是再那樣做，我就擰斷他的脖子！

NONE: C2 used to suggest a plan
我的主張（或意見、建議）是…；你聽我說

example: I'll tell you what - we'll split the money between us.
聽我說——我們兩人把錢分了吧。

NONE: › an expression that means you will not worry about a possible future problem but will deal with it if it happens
船到橋頭自然直；車到山前必有路
